name: MA☆KO HUNTER
source: Here in the strange world of Genda and Manne, there exists magic forests with elves, fairies and witches, prairies of the Wild West with cowboys... *ahem* cowgirls and indians, a prosperous medieval kingdom with princesses and knights, and modern cities. Furthermore, this world has another peculiar twist - here men and women live apart, in separated countries, and hunt each other for reproduction. Hunters are mainly woman - because woman in this world are much stronger. In ancient times they drove out men from Manne (The Mainland) to Genda (The Island) and created this sexual segregation. And here comes our hero -- a professional hunter who does not fear women, and hunts them for fun and money. But then, to finally settle down and find a woman to continue his bloodline he begins the final hunt!
translation: 在Genda和Manne的奇异世界里，有精灵、仙女和女巫的魔法森林，有牛仔……*咳咳*女牛仔和印第安人的狂野西部大草原，有公主和骑士的繁荣的中世纪王国，还有现代城市。此外，这个世界还有另一个奇特的转折——男人和女人分居在不同的国家，互相狩猎以繁衍后代。猎人主要是女性—​​—因为这个世界上的女性要强大得多。在古代，他们将男人从曼尼（大陆）驱逐到根达（岛屿），并造成了这种性别隔离。我们的英雄来了——一位职业猎人，他不怕女人，并为了乐趣和金钱而猎杀她们。但后来，为了最终安定下来并找到一个女人来延续他的血统，他开始了最后的狩猎！
